_readme: Dedicated MiMo proxy (:8020) → local MiMo vLLM (:8100). Single-model lane: regular requests preserve enable_thinking; response_format requests are rewritten to enable_thinking=false to prevent MiMo JSON being routed into reasoning_content. Copy to /home/xraan/mediallmproxy-mimo/appsettings.proxy-mimo.json before installing the paired unit.
